{'subtask': "Find the official Scikit-Learn changelog for July 2017 (likely 'What's New in 0.19.0'). Open the page and navigate to the 'Bug fixes' section. Extract and list all entries that reference base predictor methods (e.g., predict, predict_proba, decision_function, score). For each relevant entry, provide the exact quoted text, the method name(s) mentioned verbatim, and the canonical URL to the page/section. If two base methods are mentioned together or in closely related bug-fix notes, highlight the pair and note which could be considered the 'other predictor base command.' Focus on authoritative sources (official scikit-learn docs and GitHub release notes)."} Please provide the answer and detailed supporting information of the subtask given to you.
---
scikit-learn What's New 0.19.0 bug fixes site:scikit-learn.org

Summary of Work and Approach - Objective: Locate the official Scikit-Learn changelog for 0.19.0 (the release around July/August 2017), open the “Bug fixes” section, and extract entries referencing base predictor methods (predict, predict_proba, decision_function, score). Provide exact quotes, verbatim method names, and canonical URLs. Highlight pairs of closely related notes that mention two base methods. - Plan: 1. Find the authoritative “What’s New / Release history” page for scikit-learn 0.19.x. 2. Open the 0.19.0 section and navigate to “Bug fixes.” 3. Extract entries explicitly mentioning predict, predict_proba, decision_function, or score; provide exact quotes and URLs; identify closely-related pairs. - Tools Used: 1. Web search to locate the official page. 2. Page scraping to retrieve and read the exact text and anchors. Tool Use History and Results 1. Web Search - Query: "scikit-learn What's New 0.19.0 bug fixes site:scikit-learn.org" - Key results: - "Version 0.19" — https://scikit-learn.org/stable/whats_new/v0.19.html - "Release history — scikit-learn 0.19.2 documentation" — https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html (authoritative version-specific page) - "v0.19.rst.txt" — https://scikit-learn.org/dev//_sources/whats_new/v0.19.rst.txt - Other related resources (API reference, examples), but not directly needed. 2. Scrape official 0.19 page - URL: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html - Page content shows: - Version 0.19 (release date: August 12, 2017; not July, but this is the latest, authoritative 0.19.0 changelog) - Bug fixes section (anchor: #id4) under Version 0.19 - Version 0.19.1 with “Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1” (anchor: #bug-fixes under 0.19.1), containing closely related bug-fix notes referencing base methods. Findings Directly Relevant to the Task - Version 0.19 — Bug fixes section - Contains numerous fixes across subsections. Filtering strictly for explicit mentions of base predictor methods: - One entry explicitly references a base predictor method: - "Fix multioutput.MultiOutputClassifier.predict_proba to return a list of 2d arrays, rather than a 3d array. In the case where different target columns had different numbers of classes, a ValueError would be raised on trying to stack matrices with different dimensions. [#8093] by Peter Bull." - Method referenced: predict_proba - Section: Version 0.19 — Bug fixes - Canonical section URL: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#id4 - Version 0.19.1 — “Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1” - These are bug-fixes applied to regressions introduced in 0.19.0. Two entries explicitly reference base methods and are closely related: - "Fix regression in model_selection.cross_val_predict where it raised an error with method='predict_proba' for some probabilistic classifiers. [#9641] by James Bourbeau." - Method referenced: predict_proba - Canonical section URL: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#bug-fixes (under Version 0.19.1) - "Fixed handling of model_selection.cross_val_predict for binary classification with method='decision_function'. [#9593] by Reiichiro Nakano and core devs." - Method referenced: decision_function - Canonical section URL: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#version-0-19-1 (Version 0.19.1 section; the Bug fixes anchor also applies: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#bug-fixes) - These two entries form a closely-related pair because they both concern cross_val_predict’s handling of different base predictor methods. Notes on Date Discrepancy - The prompt mentions July 2017. The official 0.19.0 changelog page shows "Version 0.19 — August 12, 2017." This is the authoritative source for 0.19.0. The related regressions fixed in 0.19.1 are dated October 2017. Source Credibility - All entries and quotes are from the official scikit-learn 0.19 documentation: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html - Issue references (e.g., #8093, #9641, #9593) point to scikit-learn’s GitHub repository, which is authoritative for release issue tracking. In the case where different target columns had different numbers of classes, a ValueError would be raised on trying to stack matrices with different dimensions. [#9641] by James Bourbeau." - Method name(s) mentioned verbatim: predict_proba - Canonical URL to page/section: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#bug-fixes - Entry B: - Exact quoted text: "Fixed handling of model_selection.cross_val_predict for binary classification with method='decision_function'. [#9593] by Reiichiro Nakano and core devs." - Method name(s) mentioned verbatim: decision_function - Canonical URL to page/section: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#bug-fixes (Version 0.19.1 section; also accessible via https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#version-0-19-1) Paired methods highlighted - Pair: predict_proba and decision_function - Context: Both appear in closely related bug-fix notes within "Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1" concerning model_selection.cross_val_predict. - "Other predictor base command" when one is mentioned: - For the predict_proba note, the other predictor base command is decision_function. - For the decision_function note, the other predictor base command is predict_proba. No other entries under the Version 0.19 "Bug fixes" section explicitly mention predict, decision_function, or score by method name. Entries mentioning “prediction” in general (e.g., “parallelised prediction in random forests…”) were excluded as they do not reference the method names verbatim per criteria. This is noted; the used source remains authoritative. - No explicit mentions of predict or score in 0.19.0 bug fixes beyond the items listed above.

Retrieve and analyze the official scikit-learn v0.19 release notes source to verify exact wording of bug-fix entries that mention base predictor methods. Specifically: 1) Download and inspect the raw rST text (e.g., https://scikit-learn.org/dev/_sources/whats_new/v0.19.rst.txt) and the v0.19 HTML page (https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html). 2) Locate all occurrences of the terms: cross_val_predict, predict_proba, decision_function, predict, score. Extract the exact quoted lines from the Bug fixes sections for 0.19.0 and 0.19.1. 3) Check if any phrasing like "other predictor base command" or "other predictor base methods" appears; if found, record the exact text and context. 4) Provide canonical URLs and anchors for the relevant lines. Present findings clearly, including pairs of closely related notes that mention two base methods.

Overview - Objective: Determine, from the Scikit-Learn “July 2017” changelog context (the v0.19.x release cycle around Aug–Oct 2017), which other predictor base command received a bug fix, and provide just the method name. - Interpretation: “Predictor base command” refers to core estimator methods such as predict, predict_proba, decision_function, score. The wording “other” implies two such methods were discussed together or in closely related bug-fix notes; the task is to identify the counterpart. Methods and Actions (high-level, no internals) - Located the official scikit-learn 0.19.x “What’s New”/release notes pages. - Reviewed the v0.19 (0.19.0) Bug fixes section and v0.19.1 Bug fixes (noted as “Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1”). - Cross-checked the rendered HTML and the raw rST source to confirm exact wording, anchors, and mentions of predictor base methods (predict, predict_proba, decision_function, score). - Searched specifically for lines including cross_val_predict, predict_proba, decision_function, predict, score within bug-fix sections. - Verified that there is no literal phrase “other predictor base command” in the changelog; instead, identified a pair of closely related bug-fix notes that reference two base methods. Evidence Collected 1) Version 0.19 (0.19.0) — Bug fixes - Quote (Model evaluation and meta-estimators): “Fix multioutput.MultiOutputClassifier.predict_proba to return a list of 2d arrays, rather than a 3d array. In the case where different target columns had different numbers of classes, a ValueError would be raised on trying to stack matrices with different dimensions. [#8093] by Peter Bull.” - URL: https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#id4 - Other “prediction”/“score”-related items in 0.19.0 Bug fixes (not explicit core method names): - “Fixed excessive memory usage in prediction for random forests estimators. [#8672] by Mike Benfield.” - “Fixed oob_score in ensemble.BaggingClassifier. [#8936] by Michael Lewis.” - “model_selection.permutation_test_score now works with Pandas types. [#5697] by Stijn Tonk.” - “Fixed an integer overflow bug in metrics.confusion_matrix and hence metrics.cohen_kappa_score. [#8354], [#7929].” - These are not explicit fixes to the base methods predict or score. 2) Version 0.19.1 — Bug fixes (Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1) - Quote A: “Fix regression in model_selection.cross_val_predict where it raised an error with method='predict_proba' for some probabilistic classifiers. [#9641] by James Bourbeau.” - Quote B: “Fixed handling of model_selection.cross_val_predict for binary classification with method='decision_function'. [#9593] by Reiichiro Nakano and core devs.” - URL (section header): https://scikit-learn.org/0.19/whats_new.html#version-0-19-1 Pairing and Reasoning - Closely related bug-fix notes in v0.19.1 both concern model_selection.cross_val_predict and explicitly name predictor base methods: - method='predict_proba' - method='decision_function' - Given the phrasing “other predictor base command,” the counterpart to predict_proba in these paired fixes is decision_function. Date/Scope Notes - The 0.19.0 release page is dated August 12, 2017 (not July), but it is the authoritative changelog for that period. - The cross_val_predict bug fixes are listed under 0.19.1 (October 2017) as “Regressions in 0.19.0 fixed in 0.19.1.” The pairing of predict_proba and decision_function appears here, which aligns with the notion of “other predictor base command.” Candidate Answers Identified - decision_function — explicitly mentioned in a bug-fix note (0.19.1) paired with method='predict_proba' for cross_val_predict. - predict_proba — also received bug fixes (both in 0.19.0 for MultiOutputClassifier and in 0.19.1 for cross_val_predict), but it is the “one” typically contrasted against decision_function; the question asks for the “other.” - predict — only referenced indirectly as “prediction” in bug-fix descriptions; no explicit “predict” method fix found. - score — not directly as the estimator’s score method; mentions are function names (e.g., permutation_test_score, cohen_kappa_score) or oob_score, not the base score method. Conclusion - The paired bug-fix notes for cross_val_predict cite two predictor base methods: predict_proba and decision_function. If one is known, the “other predictor base command” is decision_function. FINAL ANSWER decision_function

LLM extracted final answer: **Step-by-step Analysis:** The agent summary shows that in the v0.19.1 bug-fix section of the July 2017-era changelog, two predictor base methods for `model_selection.cross_val_predict` were fixed: • `predict_proba` • `decision_function` Since the question asks for the “other predictor base command” (implying one of these is already known), the remaining one is `decision_function`. **Final Answer:** \boxed{decision_function} **Confidence:** 83 **Supporting Evidence:** The summary quotes two paired bug-fix notes: one for `method='predict_proba'` and the other for `method='decision_function'`. This shows `decision_function` was the other predictor base command receiving a fix. **Potential Weaknesses:** Assumes that the “other” refers to the pair of fixes for `cross_val_predict`; if the question referred to a different context within the changelog, the answer might differ.
